about: A/B test, Oct 5, 2026 (owner's request): panels 3 and 5, and panel 2 as a night reference, on two Apache-2.0 open-weight models served by fal.ai, prompted as true night scenes with no grade step. Text-to-image only: no reference images, so Deluin is described in words. Test output only; nothing here is published, and the pipeline's model is unchanged. The style prompt is techno-vistas with its two daytime clauses ('big pastel skies and enormous elegant megastructures on the horizon', 'clean and bright and hopeful') left out for night. Prompt expansion is off, so the prompt recorded is the prompt used. Hard cap: $1 for the whole test. Round 2 (owner's revision, Oct 5, 2026): the post looks like panel 1, pale faceted crystal walls with night through the windows; panel 5 gets two candidates, ERNIE re-prompted and Z-Image ControlNet from attempt 3. Final pass (owner, Oct 5, 2026): one Deluin, using the fixed description in designs/characters/deluin.json in every panel he is in; beats 1, 3, 5 and 9 on ERNIE-Image Turbo; up to three attempts per panel in this pass; $1 cap.
